newsitem.title: JAPAN: Freddie Mac launches 5-yr global notes -- Fuji Sec.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac launches 5-yr global notes -- Fuji Sec.

text.p: The Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac) launched $500 million worth of five-year global notes on Wednesday with a two-year call option, joint bookrunner Fuji Securities said.
The price will be fixed during New York trading time on Wednesday at 52 to 53 basis points over the 6-1/4 percent five-year U.S. Treasury note, Fuji Securities said.
The payment date will be on November 13, 1996, and the notes will mature on November 13, 2001.
The notes will be listed in Singapore and Luxembourg.
The other joint bookrunners are Salomon Brothers and Merrill Lynch.
